description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful NatureWalk Home:* 6-Seater Golf Cart Included + 6 Bikes Included* Two King Master Suites – Perfect for Multiple Families* Located in a Peaceful Neighborhood with Scenic Walking & Biking Trails* Access to the “Gathering Place” with Resort Pools, Hammocks, Grills, Fire Pit & Pickleball Courts* Conveniently Close to 30A’s Best Dining, Shopping, and Entertainment* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef – Details in Area Attractions Below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Guest SupportThis property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No exceptions.Welcome to Sail Away, the perfect retreat for a relaxing 30A getaway! This 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in NatureWalk at Seagrove comfortably sleeps 11—ideal for families or groups. The first floor features a bright, open living area with cozy seating, a flat-screen TV, dining for six, and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances and marble countertops. The first-floor master suite with a king bed and ensuite offers a private retreat. Upstairs, enjoy a second king master suite, a queen guest room, and a playful bunk room with twin-over-twin and trundle—perfect for kids or extra guests. Step outside to spacious balconies for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Explore nearby trails, beaches, Seaside, and WaterColor with the complimentary golf cart or six included bikes. Whether lounging by the pool, cruising the trails, or sharing family meals at home, Sail Away has everything you need for an unforgettable 30A vacation!We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates!Snowbird Season runs December through January on a monthly basis. Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us for assistance with your winter stay!The Bed Setup1st Floor:Master Suite: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Suite: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed with Twin TrundleCommon Area:Queen Sleeper SofaPlease Note: Strict age requirement of 21+ to drive the golf cart.Due to HOA restrictions, boats, RVs, and trailers are not permitted within this neighborhood. Guests will be charged $150 for a lost or missing amenity pass and $150 for a lost golf cart key. Please leave both items in the home upon departure.Area AttractionsScenic 30A is a top Florida destination with sugar-white sand beaches, emerald waters, charming beach towns, local shops, and amazing restaurants. Outdoor adventures abound, from kayaking, paddleboarding, and snorkeling to biking, hiking, fishing, and golfing—perfect for both relaxation and fun.WaterColor is a beautiful coastal community with lush landscaping, pocket parks, and views of Western Lake. Rent a kayak, paddleboard, or canoe at the WaterColor Boathouse, or enjoy beachfront dining at the WaterColor Beach Club and Fish Out of Water.Seaside is a walkable, picturesque town known for its iconic architecture and as the filming location of The Truman Show. Explore boutiques, galleries, food trucks, the Farmers Market, and the lively town square.Sea Turtle Reef is a 40-acre artificial reef just offshore from Grayton Beach State Park, perfect for snorkeling with kayaks or paddleboards in 12–19 feet of clear water. Read less
